scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:landing
scripts.build:mobile-coop: tsc --noEmit && VITE_NET_ENABLED=true VITE_SERVER_URL=wss://coop.werdumfight.com vite build && npm run build:landing
scripts.build:free: tsc --noEmit && VITE_FREE_BUILD=true vite build && npm run build:landing
scripts.build:free:coop: tsc --noEmit && VITE_FREE_BUILD=true VITE_NET_ENABLED=true VITE_SERVER_URL=wss://coop.werdumfight.com vite build && npm run build:landing
scripts.build:free:prod: tsc --noEmit && VITE_FREE_BUILD=true VITE_NET_ENABLED=true VITE_SERVER_URL=wss://coop.werdumfight.com VITE_ADMOB_TESTING=false VITE_ADMOB_REWARDED_ANDROID=ca-app-pub-8782557489858174/3806102388 VITE_ADMOB_REWARDED_IOS=ca-app-pub-8782557489858174/7161793385 VITE_ADMOB_INTERSTITIAL_ANDROID=ca-app-pub-8782557489858174/1235779365 VITE_ADMOB_INTERSTITIAL_IOS=ca-app-pub-8782557489858174/6241683713 vite build && npm run build:landing
scripts.cap:free:sync:android: FREE_BUILD=1 CAPACITOR_ANDROID_PATH=$(mktemp -d)/android npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:free:sync:ios: FREE_BUILD=1 CAPACITOR_IOS_PATH=$(mktemp -d)/ios npx cap sync ios

_comments.dev:adsim: Dev server with the SIMULATED web ad overlay enabled (VITE_WEB_AD_SIM=true). Lets you experience the real rewarded-continue / host-unlock UX on localhost. Default `dev` keeps web on NoopAdService (zero ad friction).
_comments.build:free: Web/beta build of the free app — VITE_FREE_BUILD=true activates FREE_BUILD flag; ads are no-op on web.
_comments.build:free:coop: Free app build with co-op join enabled — for the free-variant mobile app bundle (TEST ads — VITE_ADMOB_TESTING defaults true).
_comments.build:free:prod: PRODUCTION free build: real AdMob ad unit IDs (acct ca-app-pub-8782557489858174) + VITE_ADMOB_TESTING=false + co-op. Use ONLY for store builds AFTER the AdMob account is approved. App IDs (~) still go in the native manifest/Info.plist — see docs/ads-system.md.
_comments.build:mobile-coop: Premium mobile build for co-op. After running: npx cap sync then node scripts/check-native-appid.mjs to confirm premium appId was not tainted.
_comments.cap:free:sync:android: Syncs the free-variant native project to a THROWAWAY temp dir. Never touches android/ committed for the premium app in review. IMPORTANT: After any cap:free:sync, run check:native to confirm premium android/ is still clean.
_comments.cap:free:sync:ios: Syncs the free-variant native project to a THROWAWAY temp dir. Never touches ios/ committed for the premium app in review. IMPORTANT: After any cap:free:sync, run check:native to confirm premium ios/ is still clean.
_comments.check:native: Sync-guard: reads android/ and ios/ generated capacitor.config.json and FAILS if appId !== com.werdumfight.app. Run after any npx cap sync to catch accidental FREE_BUILD taint (incident: 2026-06-11).
_comments.IMPORTANT: The definitive native config for the free app (flavors, Bundle ID, AdMob IDs, Info.plist) is a user checklist item at launch — see plan CHECKLIST DO USUÁRIO.
